title: BLM-17m: A Large-Scale Dataset for Black Lives Matter Topic Detection on Twitter
models_tested: The paper does not evaluate Large Language Models. It uses traditional machine learning and NLP methods such as TF-IDF, LDA, Linear SVC, KMeans, and Logistic Regression as baselines for its proposed dataset.
findings: The paper does not analyze or contain any findings related to religion or faith. Its focus is on the social, political, and emotional aspects of the Black Lives Matter movement on Twitter.
